scenario.summary: Northbridge Technologies' fiscal 2025 results reflect the outcome of a rate case in which state utility regulators approved a rate increase below the full amount the company requested, limiting full recovery of certain operating and capital costs.

facts.effect: limited full recovery of certain operating and capital costs during the fiscal year
